description: This file defines a React functional component 'PackagesPreferencesSection' that manages and displays plugin packages/extensions within a preferences UI. It handles loading extensions, installing external plugins via URL, and uninstalling existing plugins. The component utilizes hooks like useState, useEffect, useRef, and integrates with application services for actions like downloads, alerts, and mutations.

methods.name: loadExtensions
methods.description: Fetches extensions of specific content types (ActionsExtension, Component, Theme) from the application's item store and returns them as an array of package objects.

methods.name: uninstallExtension
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation and, if accepted, deletes the specified extension from the application, then reloads the list of extensions.

methods.name: submitExtensionUrl
methods.description: Downloads and prepares an external plugin feature from a provided URL, prompting user confirmation.

methods.name: handleConfirmExtensionSubmit
methods.description: Handles user confirmation result for installing an external extension, proceeding with installation if confirmed.

methods.name: confirmExtension
methods.description: Inserts the new extension into the application and triggers a sync, updating the displayed list.
